scope_changes.accounts: One administrator; viewing connections have viewer/controller authority, not separate user accounts.
scope_changes.stability: 20 clients for four hours, accepted complete at 16280.012 seconds; no 24-hour rerun required.
scope_changes.physical_devices: Linux and mobile physical-device acceptance excluded from this round; source compatibility and automated checks retained.
scope_changes.publisher_certificate: Commercial publisher signing excluded; bundled kernel-driver signatures verified.
scope_changes.human_speech: Deferred until an actual physical microphone and speaking participant are available. Not waived or replaced by generated PCM.

requirements.requirement: Unified cross-platform Web/PWA viewing, audio, control and microphone
requirements.finding: Automated cross-browser and source compatibility coverage passed; physical mobile acceptance excluded from this round.
requirements.limit: Browser-engine checks do not establish physical Android/iOS hardware behavior.

requirements.requirement: Windows/Linux native servers and one management UI
requirements.finding: Both native build paths passed. Published Windows installer passed actual installation and full SCM restart; Linux installer passed native extraction and initialization.
requirements.limit: Windows installation ran on hosted Windows Server 2022. Linux physical desktop/GPU acceptance is excluded from this round.

requirements.requirement: One shared upstream per host/app, multiple viewers and program audio
requirements.finding: Existing real application-stream and 20-client stability evidence retained. Latest builds and gateway tests passed without rerunning the accepted soak.
requirements.limit: Historical stream/soak runs retain their original component versions and measurement scope; they are not relabelled as new release-binary end-to-end runs.

requirements.requirement: Authorized browser microphone to target recorder/UE5 and audience mix, with revocation
requirements.finding: Generated browser audio reached actual UE5 capture through the open-source provider in five authorization phases. Native PCM and installed-device lifecycle passed. Physical human speech remains unverified.
requirements.limit: UE5 route evidence uses the recorded mixed component revisions. Generated/file audio is not physical microphone speech.

requirements.requirement: Persistent sessions, lease/recovery, unique control, tickets, events and administrator operations
requirements.finding: Implemented and covered by current Go/Rust/browser suites plus existing recovery/control stream evidence, with the single-administrator scope applied.

requirements.requirement: Unified vendored source, reproducible native builds, licenses, SBOM and downloads
requirements.finding: Matching-source runtime installers and seven release assets published; both binaries and SBOM hashes match recorded verified artifacts.
requirements.limit: Publisher certificate signing is excluded by scope. Kernel-driver verification remains required and passed.

requirements.requirement: Service deployment, TLS/key handling, rate limits, recovery and lightweight operational state
requirements.finding: Implemented with protected installation data, TLS preflight, administrator authentication and login rate limiting, existing lifecycle/recovery checks, structured access/operation logs and component health. No heavy monitoring service was added.
requirements.limit: Unit and isolated deployment results do not establish a customer's WAN/TLS topology or hardware capacity.

requirements.requirement: Accepted stability, recovery, authority and audio quality checks
requirements.finding: Accepted four-hour/20-client result retained, existing reconnection/control/UE5 measurements reviewed, current cross-platform suites and released-installer lifecycle passed. Human speech remains the external acceptance gate.
requirements.limit: No new 24-hour or physical Linux/mobile acceptance is claimed.

additional_delivery_requirements.application_capture: Windows application/desktop capture and Linux X11 application isolation retain their native scope; pure Wayland application capture is not claimed. See contracts/audio-devices/linux-application-capture.md and the native Linux evidence.
additional_delivery_requirements.archives_and_local_apps: Source and current Go suite cover local executable paths plus ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR and common compressed TAR formats. Implementations: orchestrator/internal/app/archive.go and local.go; tests: archive_test.go, upload_archive_test.go and local_test.go.
additional_delivery_requirements.configuration: Unified management exposes component/gateway settings, restart applicability and encoder settings. The reviewed encoder catalog contains 79 typed fields; other native parameters can be added by name. Full semantic/range validation for arbitrary advanced native extensions is not claimed. See contracts/encoder-configuration.md and EncoderConfigurationEditor.tsx.
additional_delivery_requirements.example: Development example covers interaction and audio checks; examples and UE probes remain excluded from production installers.
additional_delivery_requirements.single_silent_installer: One installer per server platform. Windows silent installation verified using the unchanged published file. No Node.js/npm runtime dependency or VB-CABLE distribution dependency.

remaining_external_acceptance.requirement: Real physical microphone speech to target program and other viewing clients
remaining_external_acceptance.needed: A functioning physical microphone and participant speaking during a bounded browser-to-target/audience check.
remaining_external_acceptance.handling: Retain RC status and do not substitute tones, repeated builds or a second synthetic test for this result.

implementation_action: No new core implementation defect was established by this review. Existing advanced-configuration and platform limits remain explicitly documented rather than described as universally verified.
